notes.title: RADtv - OUT NOW + SURPRISE VIVE SUPPORT!
notes.content:
Hello RADtv Fans. 

We pushed it, we pushed the big button on Steam that says “Release my game!” and now it is LIVE AND AVAILABLE ON THE STORE! And as an added bonus, RADtv is also available on Vive! Rift AND Vive! 

Go tell all your friends, your parents, your siblings, your pets, your Instagram followers, your neighbours, your neighbours neighbours, your…..you get it right?

We’re so excited we even put a little discount on, AND we discounted our other title available on Steam called Fragmental (also multiplayer!). Grab the bundle if you want both.

In other good news RADtv is available now in: [i]Brazilian (Portuguese), Chinese (simplified), English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Spanish[/i]

If you run into any issues while playing RADtv, please let us know and we’ll do our best to sort them all out as quick as we can. 

Many thanks to everyone who’s wishlisted, and everyone who’s taking time to check the game out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649240/RADtv/

Ruffian Games.

notes.title: RADtv - Launch Date Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello, RADtv fans! 

Wow, do we have an announcement for you! A RADtv launch date! How many more exclamation marks can we use! The answer is loads! 

We’re super excited to let you all know that RADtv is launching on August 2nd! We can't wait for all of you to get to grips with our rather bizarre TV-world, so it’s coming out in just a couple of weeks! 

https://youtu.be/qyF3hkahZm4
If you’ve got any questions, leave them in here and we’ll bundle them up into a big post answering as many as we can. Alternatively let us know on [url=https://twitter.com/RuffianGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/RuffianGames/]Facebook[/url] or (our-brand-spanking-new) [url=https://discord.gg/Wz26pdc]Discord[/url] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649240/RADtv/

Thanks a whole bunch for wishlisting, we’d love it if you could tell your friends too! 

Ruffian Games.
